name: What is the design phase process for a whole-home renovation?
description: The design phase involves consultations, concept development, material selection, and detailed drawings, refining your vision before construction.

mainEntity.name: What is the design phase process for a whole-home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The design phase for a whole-home renovation typically begins with initial consultations to understand your vision, needs, and budget. This leads to concept development, space planning, material selection, and detailed architectural drawings. This iterative process allows for refinements and ensures all aspects of the design align with your goals before construction begins. Clear communication with your design team is critical during this stage to solidify plans.
